digest.component_or_area: CLI command structure and bridge maintenance utilities
propositions: Three CLI verbs are being renamed to use noun-based structure: bridge-fsck → bridge fsck, bridge-probe → bridge check-access, jira-onboard → bridge setup
The old verb spellings must remain as functional compatibility entrypoints that route to the same implementation without behavior changes
Every in-tree consumer and reference to the old verbs must be migrated to use the new canonical spellings across CLI, tests, scripts, workflows, and documentation
The shared onboarding function accepts an entrypoint-specific argparse prog so both old and new invocations show correct usage lines while sharing identical logic
A repository-wide stale-vocabulary test must verify no uncategorized live references remain to old spellings outside explicitly allowed categories
